changelog.title: Better defaults, smoother DX
changelog.description:
This release focuses on improving the developer experience with saner defaults, better error messages, and a few quality-of-life improvements.

## Features

- Add automatic configuration detection
- Introduce `--watch` mode for faster feedback

## Fixes

- Fix incorrect paths on Windows
- Resolve occasional crashes when config is missing

## Improved

- Clearer error messages
- Faster startup time

changelog.title: Foundation release
changelog.description: Stabilized the first public workflow and tightened the plugin metadata model.
